The '''Drayberia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] regions.<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Drayberian hawk/Legends|Drayberian hawks]].<ref name="KOTOR" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Drayberia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square R-5.<ref name="TEA" />
